summary: Lets stringifySetCookie accept expires as a millisecond timestamp as well as a Date, throwing on invalid numbers like an invalid Date does, with updated types and tests.
narrative: The owner asked for a small feature in the cookie project: stringifySetCookie should take expires as a number of milliseconds since the epoch as well as a Date. An invalid number should throw the same way an invalid Date does. The type should be updated and tests added. Memory holds no observations for this conversation yet, and the only activity is the opening ask, so no implementation, PR or release is recorded.

milestones.text: Owner asked for numeric (millisecond) expires support in stringifySetCookie, with type update and tests.
